notes: Fill protocol: (1) dotnet merge-runs mandatory before fill; (2) process ALL word/*.xml parts; (3) apply display format to numeric values; (4) byte-level bracket scan post-fill.
Headless completion criteria: targets-exist + placeholder-free only. reference-alignment blocked by .doc format + canonicalize_numeric_token comma-separator bug. soft-document-quality requires LLM.
Validator scanning path: deployment/outputs/ is the authoritative path. task-pack-root/outputs/ is an implementation artifact — both must be kept in sync.

Blank-agent pre-conditions: expert-workspace must be seeded with manifest.md, change_log.md, surface_contract.json, lessons/failure_lessons.md, and rules/ directory (docx_fill_rules.md, execution_checklist.md, xlsx_inspection_rules.md, legacy_doc_rules.md) BEFORE invocation. Empty workspace causes first-tool-call crash.
Dispatch ticket repair protocol: after producing repair evidence, update dispatch-tickets.json ticket status AND routing-control readyForFinalAcceptance atomically in the same session.

Pre-promotion sanitization: ALL files in pending-expert-package/current/ (especially lessons/failure_lessons.md and rules/ files) must be scanned for task-specific numeric literals before promoting to expert-workspace. Apply generic placeholders to numeric example content — do NOT embed specific literal patterns. Expert-surface-generalization validator scans ALL package files — historical examples in failure_lessons.md are NOT exempt.
